Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed BALF samples from healthy, acute COVID, and recovered COVID patients. While the paper describes extensive in vitro perturbations (SARS-CoV-2 infection of NHBE cells), those were analyzed via turbidity assays, Western blots, and RNAseq, not the mass spectrometry proteomics described in the 'Proteomics analyses by mass spectrometry' section. Therefore, only the clinical disease state variable is extracted for the proteomics dataset.
